name: FOLLOW-ME
summary: Virtual guides around each object that slow the cursor and steer it onto the target as it approaches.
howItWorks: The space around each object is split into three zones. Far away, the control-display gain is 1 or higher; in the middle zone it is reduced for precision; in the innermost zone a virtual guide constrains the cursor's motion towards the object. It can be added to other techniques.

review.notes: Added from Weise, Zender & Lucke 2019 (Oct 2026). Attributes drafted by Claude from the survey descriptions and the original paper's abstract; not yet checked against the paper.
